verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth documents enterprise Single Sign-On over SAML 2.0. OIDC is only covered through a generic Custom OAuth/OIDC provider mechanism on the social-login page, not as enterprise workforce SSO, and a community user was unsure whether OIDC-based SSO is supported. missing for 10: documented OIDC enterprise SSO, named Okta/Entra/Google Workspace setup guides, workforce-specific configuration detail (domain mapping, attribute mapping), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can connect enterprise identity providers over SAML and OIDC (Okta, Entra, Google Workspace) for workforce sign-in

citations.quote: Add Single Sign-On for enterprise applications with SAML 2.0.
To add a provider that isn't listed, use [Custom OAuth/OIDC Providers](/docs/guides/auth/custom-oauth-providers).
